The intent action android.intent.action.CLOSE_SYSTEM_DIALOGS (used to send a broadcast) matches the intent filter of a non-exported receiver, registered via a call to Context.registerReceiver, or similar. If you are trying to invoke this specific receiver via the action then you should use Intent.setPackage(<APPLICATION_ID>).
As of Android 12, android:exported must be set; use true to make the activity available to other apps, and false otherwise. For launcher activities, this should be set to true.
